Welcome to my site! I'm a Data Scientist at UT Southwestern Medical Center, where I build AI systems and statistical pipelines for cancer research. My work spans LLM-based clinical data extraction, RNA-seq and microbiome bioinformatics, survival analysis, and open-source scientific software — with a focus on health equity and translating methods into tools that clinicians and researchers can actually use.

I came to data science through an unusual path: chemistry degree, clinical data coordination, then a master's in data science while working full-time in oncology research. That background means I think about data problems from both the bench and the keyboard.

[Learn more about my background](about.qmd)

# Projects & Writing

Below are write-ups from my research projects — not just the methods, but the decisions, trade-offs, and open questions behind them. Posts are tagged with specific techniques for discoverability. Many of my coding projects for my degree and research position are in private repositories; feel free to reach out for more information.
